mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID AS "userID" , U.USER_STATUS AS "userStatus" , U.FIRST_NAME AS "firstName" , U.LAST_NAME AS "lastName" , U.EMAIL AS "email" , '' AS "department" , COALESCE(U.LAST_LOGIN,'') AS "lastLogin" FROM USERS U WHERE ( (COALESCE(#{userStatus}, '00') = '00' AND U.USER_STATUS IN ('01', '09')) OR (COALESCE(#{userStatus}, '00') != '00' AND U.USER_STATUS = #{userStatus}) ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR U.USER_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR U.FIRST_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR U.LAST_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' ) ORDER BY U.PROCESS_TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM USERS U WHERE ( (COALESCE(#{userStatus}, '00') = '00' AND U.USER_STATUS IN ('01', '09')) OR (COALESCE(#{userStatus}, '00') != '00' AND U.USER_STATUS = #{userStatus}) ) AND ( NULLIF(#{search}, '') IS NULL OR U.USER_ID ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR U.FIRST_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR U.LAST_NAME ILIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' )

SELECT U.USER_ID AS "userID" , U.USER_STATUS AS "userStatus" , U.FIRST_NAME AS "firstName" , U.LAST_NAME AS "lastName" , U.PASSWORD AS "password" , U.EMAIL AS "email" , U.ENABLED AS "enabled" , U.REQUIRES_PASSWORD_RESET AS "requiresPasswordReset" , U.BRANCH_CODE AS "branchCode" , U.NON_LOCKED AS "nonLocked" , U.USER_TYPE AS "userType" , U.FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS AS "failedLoginAttempts" , U.EFFECTIVE_DATE AS "effectiveDate" , U.FIRST_REGISTER_USER AS "firstRegisterUser" , U.FIRST_REGISTER_DATE AS "firstRegisterDate" , U.LAST_CHANGE_DATE AS "lastChangeDate" , U.PROCESS_TIMESTAMP AS "processTimestamp" FROM USERS U WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userID}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, USER_STATUS, FIRST_NAME, LAST_NAME, PASSWORD, EMAIL, ENABLED, REQUIRES_PASSWORD_RESET, BRANCH_CODE, NON_LOCKED, USER_TYPE, FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS, FIRST_REGISTER_BRANCH, FIRST_REGISTER_USER, FIRST_REGISTER_DATE, FIRST_REGISTER_TIME, LAST_CHANGE_BRANCH, LAST_CHANGE_USER, LAST_CHANGE_DATE, LAST_CHANGE_TIME, EFFECTIVE_DATE, LAST_LOGIN ) VALUES ( #{userID}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userStatus}, ''), '01'), #{firstName}, #{lastName}, #{password}, #{email}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{requiresPasswordReset}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{branchCode}, ''), COALESCE(#{nonLocked}, 'N'), COALESCE(#{userType}, 'SYSUSER'), COALESCE(#{failedLoginAttempts}, '0'), #{firstRegisterBranch}, #{firstRegisterUser}, #{firstRegisterDate}, #{firstRegisterTime}, #{lastChangeBranch}, #{lastChangeUser}, #{lastChangeDate}, #{lastChangeTime}, COALESCE(#{effectiveDate}::TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{lastLogin}, '') )
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET FIRST_NAME = COALESCE(#{firstName}, FIRST_NAME) , LAST_NAME = COALESCE(#{lastName}, LAST_NAME) , PASSWORD = COALESCE(#{password}, PASSWORD) , EMAIL = COALESCE(#{email}, EMAIL) , ENABLED = COALESCE(#{enabled}, ENABLED) , REQUIRES_PASSWORD_RESET = COALESCE(#{requiresPasswordReset}, REQUIRES_PASSWORD_RESET) , BRANCH_CODE = COALESCE(#{branchCode}, BRANCH_CODE) , NON_LOCKED = COALESCE(#{nonLocked}, NON_LOCKED) , USER_STATUS = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{userStatus}, ''), USER_STATUS) , USER_TYPE = COALESCE(#{userType}, USER_TYPE) , FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS = COALESCE(#{failedLoginAttempts}, FAILED_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS) , LAST_CHANGE_USER = #{lastChangeUser} , LAST_CHANGE_DATE = #{lastChangeDate} , LAST_CHANGE_TIME = #{lastChangeTime} , EFFECTIVE_DATE = COALESCE(#{effectiveDate}::TIMESTAMP, EFFECTIVE_DATE) WHERE USER_ID = #{userID}
